$comment: Apify-backed discovery for roles at companies not on a known ATS. Costs money per result, so keep `limit` tight and lean on the ATS boards above for companies you already care about. maxSpendPerDayUsd is SEPARATE from enrich.maxSpendPerDayUsd: discovery costs $0.0004 a result and a contact lookup costs $0.14, so one budget over both lets two lookups starve the thing that feeds the funnel.
